title: Tempo Provider Score
description: Declarative definition of a Tempo source: identifier, display, color, surface, severity/indicator/tag rules, grouping, triage, and default actions.

_bundledVersion.description: Version stamp used by Tempo's bundled-score seeder to detect updates. Only meaningful in the JSON shipped inside the app; omit it in shared/community scores.

_comment.description: Free-text author note about this score. Ignored by Tempo; JSON has no comment syntax, so this is the place to leave one.

providerIdentifier.description: Stable, namespaced identifier for the source (reverse-DNS or scripts.<lang>.<name>).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the source panel.

color.description: Accent color for this source, as #RRGGBB.

eventPattern.description: How events from this source behave over time. 'episodic' (default) = standalone occurrences; 'entity' = state changes of a long-lived subject driven via externalID; 'run-bound' = steps of a finite multi-step run (activates the lifecycle UI).

surface.description: Which pane the events render on. 'timeline' = alert feed + heatmap, participates in the needs-attention model. 'agenda' = calendar/reminders context, read-only, neutral pill. When omitted, falls back to the event's type (alert -> timeline, else agenda).

senderSeverityWins.description: When true (default), a payload's explicit non-info severity short-circuits the rules. When false, score rules always run, letting the user reclassify events from senders that over-declare severity.

severityDefault.description: Fallback severity/label/color when no severity rule matches.

severityRules.description: Ordered list of severity rules. First match wins. Evaluated against event metadata at render time.

label.description: Short badge label shown in the UI.

color.description: Pill color override (#RRGGBB). Lets a rule tint its badge independently from the severity tier.

title.description: Title override (${metadata.xxx} interpolated). Replaces the event title when the rule matches.

subtitle.description: Subtitle override (${metadata.xxx} interpolated). Shown under the title in the alert card.

indicatorRules.description: Ordered list of indicator (emoji) rules, independent from severity. First match wins.

color.description: Legacy named-or-hex color; migrated to the closest circle emoji on load. New rules should use 'emoji' instead.

tagRules.description: Ordered list of tag rules, independent from severity. First match wins.

ackRules.description: Auto-acknowledge rules. When a rule matches an incoming event, Tempo marks it acknowledged at ingest (kept in the timeline, but off the dock badge and no sound).

dismissRules.description: Auto-dismiss rules. When a rule matches an incoming event, Tempo dismisses it at ingest (dropped from the live timeline; kept in the DB until retention prunes it).

grouping.description: Legacy stack-grouping key template(s). Events sharing the resolved key collapse into one stack. Supports ${metadata.xxx} interpolation. Provide a single string, or an array for a fallback chain (runtime picks the first template that fully resolves). For per-rule stacking use 'groupingRules' instead.

groupingWindow.description: Time window inside which related events stack (e.g. '30m', '1h', '6h', '1d', '1w'). Empty string = no cutoff (events stack regardless of gap).

stackTitle.description: Template that overrides the stack primary's title when this source's events render as a grouped stack (${metadata.xxx}, ${title}, ${providerIdentifier}). Single-event rows ignore it.

groupingRules.description: Per-rule stacking declarations (the general stacking model). First match wins. When omitted, the legacy 'grouping' + 'groupingWindow' primitive applies.

role.description: session: 'opens'/'closes' (a subject leaves and returns to rest) and 'continues' (a 'still <state>' resend joins the open episode). punctual: 'single' (never stacks) / 'repeats' (stacks repetitions of the same key within window).

key.description: Subject-key template (${metadata.clientMac}). Events whose key resolves equal form one episode/series. Required for opens/closes/continues/repeats; ignored for single.

window.description: 'repeats' only: max stack span from the anchor (e.g. '30m', '6h', '1d'). Omit for an unbounded history.

stackColor.description: Per-rule override of how the stack header derives its color. Omit for the mechanism default (session -> current state, repeats -> worst severity).

restStateOverrides.description: Rest-state classification for heterogeneous sources. groupingRules assume rest = on (a server: down 'opens' the cycle). Each override marks subjects whose rest state is off (a TV: on 'opens') so the engine swaps opens<->closes for them.

closedCycleSeverity.description: Severity of a resolved cycle for the matched subjects. 'warning' = stays in needs-attention until acked; 'info' (default) = quiet.

defaultActions.description: Actions offered for every event from this source. Per-event actions from the payload are appended.

match.description: Key/value pairs matched against event metadata. Every key must be present and its stringified value compare equal. String values support shell-style globs (* and ?).

helper.description: Descriptor for a companion helper/proxy the score relies on to produce events. Existence + light metadata only; Tempo never installs or runs it.

summary.description: One-line description of what the helper does.

platforms.description: OS variants that ship in the package, by file extension ('sh', 'py', 'ps1'). Display hint only.

url.description: External location when the helper is not bundled beside the score.

triageRule.description: An auto-ack or auto-dismiss rule: if metadata matches, fire.

color.description: Optional pill color override for the default badge.

_disabled.description: When true, the action ships disabled by default; the user can enable it in the Score Editor's Actions tab.

openURL.description: URL to open. Supports ${metadata.xxx} interpolation. Schemes allowed in reviewed catalog: http, https, ssh, mailto, tel, and documented app schemes.

openTerminalWith.description: Shell command to open in Terminal. NOT allowed in reviewed catalog — local drop-in only.
